name: Eglin AFB
tagline: Home of the 96th Test Wing and F-35 training, on Florida's Emerald Coast.
_note: Large Air Force test and training base about three miles southwest of Valparaiso, Okaloosa County, FL (Central time). BAH MHA FL056 (Eglin AFB) via the bah_rates single source of truth. Housing: Mayroad (bought the project from Corvias sold the project to Harrison Street in December 2021; renamed Mayroad); Military Housing Office 850-882-4533 ext. 3. Schools: Okaloosa County (A for 2025-26); Eglin Elementary on base. Medical: Eglin Hospital (96th Medical Group) with a 24/7 ER and labor and delivery. Corrected 2026-11-15 from Military OneSource, DeCA, WUWF, Get The Coast, Stars and Stripes, WLRN and the Mid-Bay Bridge Authority (page-builder research/eglin-facts.md). Gate hours, home count and neighborhood names unverified (eglin.af.mil refuses automated readers). Medium-confidence flags: base coords (approx), representative off-base ZIP 32547 (Fort Walton Beach).

data.Location: About three miles southwest of Valparaiso, Okaloosa County, FL

sections.title: Mission & Identity
data: Eglin's host, the 96th Test Wing, carries out developmental test and evaluation of weapons. The base serves about 20,000 personnel, with five wings, four wing equivalents and 35 associate units, and hosts some 40 tenant units (Military OneSource).

The 33rd Fighter Wing trains F-35 pilots and maintainers. Eglin also hosts the 53rd Wing, the U.S. Army's 7th Special Forces Group at Camp Bull Simons, the Army Ranger Camp and the Navy EOD School. Hurlburt Field is a separate base five miles west of Fort Walton Beach.

data.subtitle: Start with where the sponsor works, then weigh the coast's storm exposure against the north side's drive through the range on State Road 85.
intro: Eglin's main base is just southwest of Valparaiso, but its jobs are spread out: 7th Special Forces Group works at Camp Bull Simons, and Hurlburt Field is a separate base five miles west of Fort Walton Beach.

Near the coast, homes face storm risk: Hurricane Isaias made landfall near Destin in October 2026, and Citizens policyholders with wind coverage must add flood insurance by January 1, 2027. To the north, Crestview is cheaper on Zillow's index but a longer drive through the range.

recommendations.advice: About 4 to 8 minutes to the East Gate (no-traffic estimates). Niceville High earned an A for 2025-26 and graduated 98.6% in 2024-25; check the zoned school for any address. Parts of Niceville were in the zones ordered to evacuate for Hurricane Isaias.

About 4 minutes from Shalimar and 15 from Fort Walton Beach to the West Gate (no-traffic estimates), between Eglin and Hurlburt. School grades are mixed for 2025-26 (Fort Walton Beach High B, Choctawhatchee High C), and the Brooks Bridge rebuild runs to early 2029 (June 2026 schedule).

About 31 minutes to the West Gate on State Road 85 (no-traffic estimate). 60% of 7th Special Forces Group families live in Crestview (Military Times, 2024). Test missions have closed SR 85 and SR 123 in blocks of up to 90 minutes. Zillow's typical home value is $287,751 (September 2026).

About 26 minutes to the West Gate (no-traffic estimate); Zillow's typical home value is $616,654. Hurricane Isaias made landfall near Destin on October 9, 2026, and Destin High's 2024-25 graduation rate was 83.8%.

source.label: Military Times, 7th Special Forces Group families (2024)

sections.title: Gates & Access
data: The East Gate is on State Road 397 in Valparaiso; the West Gate is off State Road 85 (Eglin Parkway), at Eglin Boulevard on map data.
Since May 7, 2025, visitors 18 and older need a REAL ID or a valid passport to get a pass. The Visitor Center is at the Air Force Armament Museum, 100 Museum Dr., 850-883-0948; call ahead for hours.
We couldn't confirm gate hours from an official page, so check them with the base before you go.

sections.title: On-Base Housing
data: Mayroad owns and manages Eglin's family housing and leases directly to families (Military OneSource). Corvias, the original owner, sold the project to Harrison Street in December 2021, and it was renamed Mayroad (Niceville.com, 2022).
Contact the Military Housing Office as soon as you know you're moving: 2950 Azalea Dr., Building 38499, 850-882-4533, ext. 3, Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.

source.label: DoD 2026 BAH Rates, MHA FL056 (Eglin AFB)

sections.title: Schools
data: Military OneSource says the Okaloosa County School District serves most families near Eglin and names no DoD school at Eglin. Base housing is served by Eglin Elementary on base (kindergarten to grade 4), then Lewis and Niceville High. In the state's 2025-26 grades, as reported by local news, Okaloosa earned an A, with 23 A schools and four C's; check the zoned school for any off-base address. Destin is in Okaloosa County and Freeport in Walton County.

2024-25 graduation rates: Okaloosa 91%, Florida 92.2%, Niceville High 98.6%, Crestview High 99%, Destin High 83.8%. Schools are assigned by address, so confirm the campus for any home. School Liaison: 850-882-4319 or 850-883-3545 (Military OneSource lists both).

data.Care: 53 beds with an intensive care unit, a 24/7 emergency room (850-883-8227) and labor and delivery; Stars and Stripes reported on October 9, 2026 that all three would stay open during Hurricane Isaias

data.Commissary: Eglin AFB Commissary, 1511 Memorial Trail: open 8 a.m. to 7 p.m. daily, closed Thanksgiving and Christmas Day

intro: Whether to rent or buy is the biggest money decision of most PCS moves, and the answer is mostly about how long you'll be here and how steady the local market is.
rent: Your tour is short (about two years or less) or your orders feel uncertain.
You want time to learn the area before committing to a neighborhood.
You'd rather not gamble on resale timing when you PCS out.
Your BAH comfortably covers rent in the areas you'd consider.
buy: You expect to be here three or more years.
You want to use your VA loan and build equity instead of paying rent.
The market is steady and you could rent the home out later if needed.
You've found a neighborhood and commute you're confident about.
data.bottom_line: There is no universal right answer. Zillow's typical home value is $616,654 in Destin, $435,260 in Niceville and $287,751 in Crestview (September 2026). Before you buy, check the evacuation and flood zones, price wind and flood insurance, and ask how Amendment 3's residency date applies to you. Talk to a lender and an agent who work with military families before you commit.

intro: The first month at a new duty station is mostly logistics. Knocking these out early makes everything else easier.

steps.title: Line up temporary lodging
steps.text: Book on-base lodging or a short-term rental before you arrive. You can claim Temporary Lodging Expense (TLE) for a limited number of days while you house-hunt.

steps.title: In-process and update DEERS
steps.text: Report to your unit and finance, and make sure DEERS and ID cards are current for every family member so TRICARE and base access work.

steps.title: Start with the Housing Office
steps.text: Contact the Military Housing Office (850-882-4533, ext. 3) as soon as you know you're moving, and check the evacuation and flood zones for any off-base home before you sign.

steps.title: Sort your vehicle and access
steps.text: If your legal residence is another state, you can keep a current home-state plate; Eglin stopped requiring on-base vehicle registration in 2007. Visitors 18 and older need a REAL ID or a valid passport for a pass from the Visitor Center at the Air Force Armament Museum; CAC and Uniformed Services ID holders don't need one.

steps.title: Enroll the kids in school
steps.text: Contact Okaloosa County (or Walton County) schools early and bring records and immunizations.

steps.title: Set up healthcare
steps.text: Update your TRICARE enrollment so you can be seen at the Eglin Hospital or network providers.

data.a: The 96th Test Wing carries out developmental test and evaluation of weapons, and the 33rd Fighter Wing trains F-35 pilots and maintainers. Eglin also hosts the 53rd Wing, the Army's 7th Special Forces Group, the Army Ranger Camp and the Navy EOD School, about 20,000 personnel in all (Military OneSource).

Start with where the sponsor works. Niceville and Valparaiso are about 4 to 8 minutes from the East Gate, Shalimar and Fort Walton Beach 4 to 15 minutes from the West Gate, and Crestview about 31 minutes away (no-traffic estimates); 60% of 7th Special Forces Group families live in Crestview (Military Times, 2024).

Hurricane season runs June 1 to November 30. Hurricane Isaias made landfall near Destin on October 9, 2026 with 105 mph winds, and Okaloosa ordered Zones A and B to evacuate, covering Okaloosa Island and parts of coastal Fort Walton Beach, Destin, Mary Esther and Niceville. Check the zone for any address.
Eglin AFB is MHA FL056. Use the calculator above for your grade.

data.q: What does Amendment 3 mean for buyers?
data.a: Florida voters passed Amendment 3 on November 3, 2026 (results unofficial until certified). It takes effect January 1, 2027 and raises the non-school homestead exemption, but owners who aren't permanent Florida residents by December 31, 2026 get a smaller exemption until their fifth year of receiving a homestead exemption.
